finding.attacker_condition: Authenticated low-privilege user controls the import URL.
finding.server_condition: The default import feature is enabled and the service can make outbound HTTP requests.
finding.security_impact: Docker evidence confirms outbound callback reachability only; response, configuration, credential, and sensitive-data exposure are not claimed.

docker_evidence.expected_observation: The listener records one request from the target container.
docker_evidence.observed_observation: The replay log contains DIRECT_IMPACT_CONFIRMED after the listener receives the callback.

entrypoint_evidence.input_shape: JSON body field url controlled by a low-privilege user.
entrypoint_evidence.entrypoint_to_sink_path: POST /api/import parses the url parameter and reaches the server-side HTTP fetch helper inside Docker Compose.
entrypoint_evidence.deterministic_impact_oracle: The listener records one request from the target container and the replay log contains DIRECT_IMPACT_CONFIRMED.

replay_material.description: Bundle-root helper and replay log reproduce the attacker-entrypoint path.

entries.input_to_sink_chain: The import URL parameter reaches the server-side HTTP client without network-range validation.
entries.missing_guard: No private-address denylist or resolved-IP validation is applied before the fetch.
entries.verified_impact_boundary: Docker evidence proves callback reachability only and does not prove response disclosure.
